title: Guard canonical transport-boundary projection in worker scoreboard
mission: Add a deterministic regression that exercises scripts/build-worker-scoreboard.mjs with a v3.30 pooled historical transport-blocked terminal: raw exam close_reason=CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED plus its durable no-allocation outcome. Prove the published scoreboard path uses canonicalPoolTerminalClose, classifies the terminal EARLY_CLOSE_EXPLAINED/TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY, and reports zero unjustified early terminals for that fixture. Wire the regression into the existing efficiency-ratchet guard. Do not rewrite historical exam/no-allocation evidence or create a second residency semantics.
definition_of_done: A deterministic test fails if build-worker-scoreboard regresses to classifying the raw diagnostic CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED as an unjustified terminal.
The fixture preserves the historical exam and no-allocation semantics: diagnostic outcome CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED, canonical close_reason TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY, at least one durable close evidence ref.
The test observes pool_residency_integrity.unjustified_early_terminal_count=0 for the isolated fixture and the launch row is EARLY_CLOSE_EXPLAINED.
The regression is wired into .github/workflows/efficiency-ratchet.yml or an already-canonical equivalent guard.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, product bytes, historical exam bytes or claim authority is changed.
